from api import submit
from queueing import payload
from worker import execute


def test_submit_defaults_to_20():
    received = []
    submit("o", received.append)
    assert received == [{"owner": "o", "batch_size": 20}]


def test_submit_custom_batch_size():
    received = []
    submit("o", received.append, batch_size=7)
    assert received == [{"owner": "o", "batch_size": 7}]


def test_submit_kwargs():
    received = []
    submit("o", received.append, batch_size=3)
    assert received == [{"owner": "o", "batch_size": 3}]


def test_legacy_positional_subscribe():
    received = []
    submit("o", received.append)
    assert received[0]["owner"] == "o"


def test_reject_bool():
    for bad in (True, False):
        try:
            submit("o", lambda x: x, batch_size=bad)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("expected ValueError for %r" % (bad,))


def test_reject_non_int():
    for bad in (0, 101, "20", 2.5, None):
        try:
            submit("o", lambda x: x, batch_size=bad)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("expected ValueError for %r" % (bad,))


def test_reject_before_enqueue():
    calls = []
    def bad_enqueue(p):
        calls.append(p)
        raise AssertionError("enqueue must not be called")
    submit("o", bad_enqueue, batch_size=0)
    submit("o", bad_enqueue, batch_size=True)
    submit("o", bad_enqueue, batch_size=101)
    assert calls == []


def test_owner_preserved():
    p = payload("owner-123", 42)
    assert p["owner"] == "owner-123"
    assert p["batch_size"] == 42


def test_worker_uses_task_batch_size():
    out = execute({"owner": "o", "batch_size": 9}, lambda owner, bs: (owner, bs))
    assert out == ("o", 9)


def test_worker_legacy_defaults_to_20():
    out = execute({"owner": "o"}, lambda owner, bs: (owner, bs))
    assert out == ("o", 20)


def test_worker_missing_batch_key_defaults_to_20():
    out = execute({"owner": "o", "extra": 1}, lambda owner, bs: bs)
    assert out == 20
